name: yurirtc
description: Path-portable WebRTC content transport, signaling, service worker, and content node.

scripts.build:release: npm run build -w @edurocks-group/loader && npm run build:release -w learnmathedu
scripts.test:e2e: cd content-node && YURIRTC_BROWSER_E2E=1 go test -count=1 -run TestBrowserV3EndToEnd -v
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:package -w @edurocks-group/loader && npm run verify:package -w learnmathedu
